Hi Priya / Gabe,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we're all aligned. Please reply inline where I missed anything.

Key pain points you shared:
- PHI must remain in-customer-region and never leave Acme Health-managed storage (data residency requirement).
- Network is air-gapped for the pilot environments; only tightly controlled egress allowed for telemetry/patching windows.
- Procurement requires a short security questionnaire + SOC 2 summary before we can start procurement.
- Expected peak inference is ~80 QPS for the PoC (text generation + extraction), with burst capacity to 200 QPS.

Goals discussed:
- Validate Private (VPC) deployment to meet data residency and isolation needs for pilot.
- Confirm networking and firewall rules required for VPC peering / private connectivity or on-prem air-gapped install.
- Provide SOC2/encryption-at-rest details and mutual action plan so procurement can schedule a contract review.

Technical notes / constraints we heard:
- Customer-managed KMS required (bring-your-own-key).
- No outbound internet from pilot subnet except for curated update windows via proxy.
- All nodes must trust Acme CA for internal certs.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) Priya/Gabe: Share the network contact and the VPC/firewall rule template (I attached our networking Qs).
2) Marissa & Chloe: We'll provide (a) a filled SOC2 summary, (b) a Private deployment checklist, and (c) a proposed mutual action plan by EOD Wednesday.
3) Schedule 60-minute technical deep-dive with your network/infra team next week to walk through specifics (we suggested Wed/Thu).

Attachments: redwood-private-deploy-checklist.xlsx, networking-questions.pdf

Thanks, looking forward to the next steps.

Best,

Marissa, thanks for the thorough recap. A few inline answers and clarifications below.

> PHI must remain in-customer-region and never leave Acme Health-managed storage
Yes, US-only (primary region us-east-1). We cannot accept cross-region backups for the pilot.

> Network is air-gapped for the pilot environments; only tightly controlled egress allowed for telemetry/patching windows.
Correct, the pilot env is effectively air-gapped. We have a jump-host/proxy model that can be opened on a maintenance window. No outbound to public internet from the pilot subnets.

> Expected peak inference is ~80 QPS (burst 200)
We expect 80 p95 with short bursts to 200. We'll confirm exact traffic profile after we run a small synthetic test.

Procurement timeline: procurement wants SOC2 summary + red-team checklist before budget approval; target to finish procurement by end of Q1 2027.

Attached: acmehealth-vpc-requirements.docx (network team filled some fields)

Open questions for Redwood:
- Do you support BYOK (we use AWS KMS/HSM)?
- Can the Redwood runtime run fully air-gapped (no egress) or do you require periodic outbound for updates/telemetry?
- Which ports/protocols do we need open for the initial install vs ongoing operations?

We can do the technical deep-dive on Wed Dec 8 at 10am PT or Thu Dec 9 at 11am PT — either works for Gabe and me.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Director, Cloud Infrastructure
Acme Health
priya.shah@acmehealth.com
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>

Subject: Fwd: AcmeHealth: Private VPC discovery recap & next steps

Marissa, forwarding a couple of SE notes to include in the response. Summary for the deep-dive:

- BYOK: We support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS) for encryption at rest and can integrate with customer HSMs for key wrapping.
- Air-gapped: We offer two deployment options that meet an air-gap requirement: (1) fully on-prem air-gapped package (requires physical install + offline package delivery) and (2) Private VPC with strict egress controls and maintenance windows. For the pilot, if they require zero egress, plan for option (1).
- Ports: Installer needs outbound for package validation (one-time) if not using offline bundle. Runtime traffic mostly internal; we'll provide a short port checklist but expect TCP 22 for jumphost access (if allowed), and specific ports for internal orchestration (we'll list).
- Additional infra requirements: NTP access, ability to mount EBS/roled storage, and support for our metrics collector (can be configured to push to their internal telemetry endpoint during maintenance windows).

Action for us: prepare an offline install checklist + SOC2 summary + short list of required ports. I'll draft the SE doc and drop in the Drive link before EOD.

SE note: schedule 60-min deep-dive with Acme infra (include our infra architect, Jonah Lee).

-Chloe
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
